input.question: What sport does James Tilley play?

documents.text: James Tilley (rugby league) James Tilley (born 11 November 1993) is a Jamaican rugby league footballer who plays for Whitehaven R.L.F.C. in Kingstone Press League 1. In 2013, Tilley made his début for the club against Super League club Castleford Tigers. Tilley started his career playing for amateur club Ince Rose Bridge in his hometown of Wigan. He studied The Sutton Academy in St Helens. He was signed by St. Helens at the age of 10.
